definitions.explanation: Two weeks ago. The week that came before last week.

examples.japanese: {先々週|せんせんしゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met them the Sunday before last.

examples.japanese: {先々週|せんせんしゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いている→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I've had a cold since the week before last.

examples.japanese: {先々週|せんせんしゅう}⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}していない→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I still haven't checked the contents of the package that arrived the week before last.

notes:
{先々週|せんせんしゅう} is formed by doubling the {先|せん} prefix to push further into the past: {先|せん} (previous) + {先|せん} (previous) + ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧ (week).

RELATIVE TIME SERIES (WEEKS):
- ⟦{再来週|さらいしゅう}→再来週：01416_saraishuu⟧: the week after next
- ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧: next week
- ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧: this week
- ⟦{先週|せんしゅう}→先週：00752_senshuu⟧: last week
- {先々週|せんせんしゅう}: the week before last

PARALLEL PATTERNS:
The {先々|せんせん}〜 pattern works for other time units too:
- ⟦{先々月|せんせんげつ}→先々月：21528_sensengetsu⟧: the month before last
- {一昨年|おととし}/{先々年|せんせんねん}: the year before last
- {一昨日|おととい}: the day before yesterday

USAGE:
Used in everyday conversation. No special formality — equally natural in casual and polite speech.
